audience: developers and support teams who run user sign-in on Stytch

useCases.title: Look up a user and their login methods
useCases.text: Search users by filter, then read one user with its emails, phone numbers, login methods and roles. Stytch says search is slow, so keep it out of login flows.

useCases.title: Check the active sessions of a user
useCases.text: List the active sessions of one user, with the authentication factors and expiry time of each session.

useCases.title: Review a B2B organization and its members
useCases.text: Search B2B organizations, read the settings of one organization, then search the members of that organization.

useCases.title: End a session on a lost device
useCases.text: List the sessions of a user to find the session id. Revoke that session. Its tokens stop at once, so the user must sign in again.
